ai_summary: Steel City Securities Limited declared a 10% interim dividend, signaling positive financial performance for shareholders. Strategically, the company made Steel City Infotech Private Limited a wholly-owned subsidiary, intending to expand into the insurance broking business through it, and simultaneously approved a substantial increase in its overdraft facility from Rs. 7.5 Crores to Rs. 30 Crores. This significant jump in debt capacity, coinciding with a new business venture, warrants close scrutiny regarding its justification and planned capital deployment.
